description: EDS Button on shadcn structure: variant accentPrimary | accentSecondary | neutralPrimary | neutralSecondary | neutralSecondaryIntense | neutralTertiary | criticalPrimary | criticalSecondary | criticalTertiary | inversePrimary, size small | standard | large | xLarge, iconStart/iconEnd, isLoading, isDisabled, isPressed.
